entities.summary: Chiara Di Iulio is an Italian volleyball player. She was part of the Italy women's national volleyball team at the 2010 FIVB Volleyball Women's World Championship in Japan. and 2011 Montreux Volley Masters. She played with Chateau d'Ax Urbino Volley, at the 2010–11 Women's CEV Cup.
